title: A singularity theorem in terms of asymptotic expansion
summary: We prove a sharp singularity theorem in which the classical focusing hypothesis of Hawking--Penrose theory is replaced by a condition on the asymptotic volume growth of timelike geodesics. More precisely, let $(M,g)$ be a smooth, globally hyperbolic Lorentzian manifold satisfying the strong energy condition, and let $V\subset M$ be a smooth, compact Cauchy hypersurface.
